name: Nieudany Papieros Ojca
source:
You wake up back in your childhood house in eastern Poland, and all you can do is explore your old memories. 

Go on, talk to yourself; you are alone anyway. What did you do to deserve this? Your life is becoming meaningless. You have had no job for years; even your friends have left you. All the time in the world is yours. Find out what made your life a living hell.

[From [url=https://theodore-andy-minx.itch.io/nieudany-papieros-ojca]Itch.io[/url]]
